# KSM Quantum Technologies

> KSM Quantum Technologies is a Chennai, India based technology company, established in 2014, that builds and operates its own software products, AI-powered platforms and digital business solutions. Founded and led by K. S. Murugavel (Founder & CEO). Tagline: "Building Software. Empowering Businesses."

## What the company does
Designs, engineers and runs its own software products end to end (not an outsourcing/agency shop): business platforms, AI systems, cloud infrastructure, web and mobile applications, and automation.

## Products (built and operated by KSM Quantum Technologies)
- Get4Domain — Business Technology Platform — https://get4domain.com — an all-in-one website + business software platform (CRM, invoicing, bookings, campaigns, AI studio) for 20 industries.
- SignBot — AI Trading Technology Platform — https://signbot.in — AI-driven trading technology that turns market signals into structured decisions.
- NextBOS — Next-Generation Business Operating System — https://nextbos.ai — unifies operations, data and workflows into one intelligent control layer.
- HiDude — AI-Powered Digital Assistant — https://hidude.ai — conversational AI assistant for people and teams.

## Capabilities
Software engineering, applied artificial intelligence, cloud & infrastructure, web platforms, mobile experiences, and workflow automation.

## Facts
- Founded: 2014
- Headquarters: Tidel Park, Tharamani, Chennai, Tamil Nadu 600113, India
- Founder & CEO: K. S. Murugavel
- Model: builds and operates its own SaaS products (managed, always-on)
